gamma099_summary.interpretation: This model predicts better than persistence despite0/100 fixed-endpoint wins. Prediction and intervention sensitivity alone do not establish useful coordination or return gains. Overlapping target windows and observer views are not independent samples.

gamma095_summary.interpretation: Predicts better than persistence on its own stochastic trajectories; fixed100 evaluation wins56 versus81 for matched IPPO. Forecast sensitivity is not return benefit. Different policies generate different diagnostic data; cross-policy error comparisons are descriptive. Overlapping targets/observer views are not independent samples.

history_window_audit.finding: Candidates require only a completed four-step future suffix within an episode, not a full32-step past. Cached partial histories retain visibility masks. Short episodes therefore do not wait32 steps before entering auxiliary sampling. No full-history exclusion bug was found.
